s: Everything you need to install, set up and run Weighbridge.
h: Start here · Every day · How a vehicle moves through Weighbridge
x: Weighbridge documentation Weigh vehicles, bill sales and purchases, print receipts, and keep Tally and the government portal in step — from one app on your weighbridge computer. # Start here Install Weighbridge SQL Server, then the installer. About 10 minutes. Activate your license Paste the key Mochan Labs gave you. Sign in First login and your own password. Take a tour Where everything is. # Every day Weigh a vehicle Entry and exit weights on the Token page. Bill a sale Rates, GST, round-off and the invoice. Record a purchase Inward vehicles and their billing. Print and reprint receipts Weight slip, token and tax invoice. Something wrong? Quick fixes for the common problems. # How a vehicle moves through Weighbridge Token (first weight). The vehicle arrives on the platform and its first weight is recorded. Token exit (second weight). The vehicle comes back across the scale. If it is heavier than on entry it is a sale ; if it is lighter it is a purchase . Billing. Complete the sale or purchase: party, rate, GST, charges. Weights always come from the scale; billing is the part you fill in. Receipt. Print the weight slip and tax invoice. Sync. Sales and purchases are posted to Tally and sent to the government portal automatically, and retried if either is offline. The dashboard: open vehicles and quick access to every screen. Note This guide matches Weighbridge 0.2.x. Screenshots use demo data. Screens you can t see are hidden by your role. Ask your administrator if something you need is missing.

s: Two steps — SQL Server Express, then the Weighbridge installer. Windows 10 or 11.
h: What you need · Steps · Upgrading · Installing on more than one computer
x: # What you need A Windows 10 or 11 computer (64-bit) on the weighbridge. Internet once , to download SQL Server Express. After that the app works offline (it only needs the internet to check its license and update itself). The Weighbridge installer file from Mochan Labs: Weighbridge-Setup-x.y.z.exe . Administrator rights on the computer. # Steps Install SQL Server Express. Download it from Microsoft, run it and choose Basic . Accept the defaults and let it finish completely. Run the Weighbridge installer. Accept the one administrator prompt (Windows UAC). It finds SQL Server by itself and sets up the starting database. There is nothing to type. Open Weighbridge from the desktop or Start menu. Continue with Activate your license . Tip Already have SQL Server 2016 or newer on this computer for another reason? Skip step 1. The installer detects it. Note If SQL Server isn t found, the installer says so and stops without installing half a system. Install SQL Server, then run the installer again. It is always safe to run it again, and it never overwrites an existing database . # Upgrading Don t uninstall. Either let the app update itself ( Update the app ) or run the newer installer over the old one. Your data stays. # Installing on more than one computer Install Weighbridge on each computer, then link them with Use more than one computer .

s: A new installation asks for a license key before anything else.
h: Steps · After activation
x: The first time you open Weighbridge, it shows the Activate Weighbridge screen. Paste your license key and press Activate. # Steps Copy the license key Mochan Labs sent you. Paste it into License key and press Activate . The app checks the key with the Mochan Labs license server and opens the sign-in screen. Activation needs internet . A key works on only as many computers as it was issued for. If activation fails, the screen tells you why (wrong key, key already used on its maximum number of computers, or no internet). # After activation The computer re-checks the license with the server every few hours in the background. If the internet is down, the app keeps working for a grace period set on your license, normally 7 days. Once the computer reaches the server again, the clock resets. If the grace period runs out, or the license has expired, the activation screen returns until the license is renewed. See License renewal and expiry notices . Tip Moving to a new computer? Ask Mochan Labs to release the old one first, or the key will count against both.

t: Sign in and change your password
s: First login, your own password, and what happens after wrong attempts.
h: First login · Change your password any time · Stay signed in · Locked out?
x: Sign in with your user name and password. # First login A new installation has one user, the administrator: User name Password Admin Admin@123 Weighbridge forces you to choose a new password straight away . The default only works once. # Change your password any time Click your name at the top right, then Change Password . Enter the current password and a new one (at least 6 characters). # Stay signed in You stay signed in until you choose Logout from the same menu. Close the app and reopen it and you are still in. If an administrator locks or deletes your account, you are signed out within seconds. # Locked out? 5 wrong passwords in a row lock the account. An administrator unlocks it from Users (the padlock icon). Forgot a password? An administrator resets it from the same page (the key icon). You will be asked to set a new one at your next sign-in. Forgot the administrator password too? See Fix common problems . Tip Give every person their own login. The audit log and every receipt record who did what.

t: A quick tour of the screens
s: Where to find things, in one minute.
h: The top bar · The main menu · Dark mode
x: # The top bar Item What it does ☰ menu Opens the main menu: Weighment, Masters, Reports, Accounts, Administration. Tally Sync Posts sales and purchases that are waiting to Tally right now. See Tally . Govt Sync Sends weighments that are waiting to the government portal. See Government portal . Your name Light or dark mode, Change Password , Logout . The dashboard: open vehicles on top, quick access below. # The main menu Section What s inside Weighment Token, Sale (Outward), Purchase (Inward), and Production if your site uses it. Masters Vehicles, Parties, Materials, Party Rates, Locations, Divisions. Reports Daily Log, Sale Reports, Purchase Reports, Client List, Vehicle History, Audit Log, MDTSS Sync Status. Accounts Ledgers, Account Groups, Voucher Entry, Inventory, Shifting. Administration Everything in Setup : users, hardware, printing, Tally, license and more. You only see the screens your role allows. # Dark mode Open the menu under your name and choose Dark . A True black background switch appears for night shifts. Dark mode. Tip On the Token form and the billing dialogs, press Enter to save. You rarely need the mouse at the platform.

s: Record the first weight when a vehicle arrives and the second when it leaves, on the Token page.
h: 1. New entry (first weight) · 2. Exit (second weight) · If the scale is not available · Vehicle photos · A vehicle left without finishing?
x: Every weighing starts and ends on the Token page. The big panel at the top shows the live weight from the scale, and it only lets you save once the weight is stable . # 1. New entry (first weight) Open Weighment → Token and choose New Entry . Type the Vehicle number . If the vehicle has an RFID tag, it fills in by itself when the vehicle reaches the scale. Choose the Material . Party , Driver and Place are optional. They can be added at billing. Wait for Create token at … , then press it. Enter the vehicle and material, then create the token once the weight is stable. Tip If a vehicle s empty weight is saved in the Vehicles master, a Known tare hint appears. You can use it instead of weighing the empty vehicle. This only appears if the Known-tare shortcut is on in Workflow settings . # 2. Exit (second weight) When the vehicle comes back across the scale: Choose Exit . Pick the vehicle s token from the list (the entry weight is shown next to it). Press the save button once the weight is stable. Pick the open token, then save the second weight. Weighbridge decides what it was: Exit weight is… It s a… Next step Heavier than entry (loaded on site) Sale Bill a sale Lighter than entry (unloaded on site) Purchase Record a purchase # If the scale is not available If the scale or indicator is down, users with the Approve override permission can tick Enter weight manually , type the weight and a reason . The reason is saved on the weighment and in the audit log, so use it only when you must. Important Weights on slips come from the scale. Manual weights are marked and recorded, so use them only when you have no other option. # Vehicle photos If cameras are set up ( Cameras and RFID ), the page asks for the vehicle photos before it lets you save. With no cameras configured, it says No cameras are configured , and photos aren t needed. # A vehicle left without finishing? Open tokens stay in the Exit list and on the dashboard ( Open tokens ) until they are exited. Nothing is lost.

s: Complete billing for vehicles that have been weighed out — rates, GST, charges and round-off.
h: Steps · How the amounts work · Bill numbers · Find an earlier sale
x: After a loaded vehicle is exited on the Token page it appears on Weighment → Sale (Outward) under Ready for billing . Vehicles ready for billing on top, previous receipts below. # Steps Find the vehicle and press Complete billing . Pick the Sale Type (Cash or Credit) and the Party . A party you pick here is used for the bill and the receipts. Check the line items . The material, its rate and the quantity come in by themselves. Add more lines if the vehicle carried more than one item. Check the charges (Freight, Kaanta, Daala, Incentive). Tax and Round Off are calculated for you. Press Complete sale . The receipts are ready to print straight away. Net weight 31,400 kg becomes 314 Qtl; rate × quantity gives the amount, and GST is added automatically. # How the amounts work Quantity is the net weight in your billing unit (see Printer and slip layout ). The scale always measures in kg. If your unit is Qtl, 31,400 kg is billed as 314 Qtl. Rate is the party s own rate if one is set in Parties and party rates ; otherwise the material s standard rate. Disc / Qtl is a deduction per quintal that comes off the rate. Tax is each line s taxable amount × that material s GST % ( Materials ). You can overwrite the figure if you must. Round Off brings the total to a whole rupee. It is shown on the invoice. Tip Set a party s rates once in Party Rates and every future sale to that party fills in correctly with no typing. # Bill numbers By default the bill number is the token number. If you want invoice-style numbers (for example INV/0001 ), turn on a bill-number series in Workflow settings . # Find an earlier sale Previous receipts at the bottom lists the last 15 sales. Search by sale number or vehicle number, and press Weight slip or Tax invoice to print again. See Print and reprint receipts .

s: Inward vehicles — material you buy and unload at your site.
h: Steps · What the receipt shows · Find an earlier purchase
x: A vehicle that arrives loaded and leaves empty is a purchase. After you exit it on the Token page , it appears on Weighment → Purchase (Inward) under Ready for billing , with its gross and tare weights. Vehicles waiting to be billed on top, previous purchase receipts below. # Steps Press Complete billing on the vehicle. Choose the Party . Add Gate Pass , Gate and Division if you use them. Enter the Rate (and Less if the party allows a deduction). The Amount is worked out for you. If the material is subject to royalty, set Royalty to Yes and fill in the permit number ( M11 ), the royalty weight and rate. Save. The receipt is ready to print. # What the receipt shows The purchase receipt lists the weights and a Billing block: rate, amount, GST, income tax, transit fee, GST on transit and the Net Amount . Purchase receipt with the billing block. The percentages behind GST, income tax and transit fee are set once in Workflow settings . Note Some sites also record a river weight (the weight on the transit pass) next to the weighbridge weight. Turn on Dual-location weighing in Workflow settings to get that field. # Find an earlier purchase Previous receipts lists the last 15. Search by purchase number or vehicle number and press Receipt .

s: The weight slip, the inwards token and the GST tax invoice, and how to print them again.
h: Weight slip · Inwards token · Tax invoice · Print again
x: Weighbridge prints three documents. Each opens in its own page with a Print button. Document When Where to open it Weight slip After a sale or purchase Weight slip (Sale page), Receipt (Purchase page) Inwards token When a vehicle first arrives Right after you create the token Tax invoice After a sale Tax invoice (Sale page) # Weight slip Company name, date, vehicle, party, token and material, then Gross , Empty vehicle and Net weight, and time in and out. On A4 landscape, two copies print side by side. You set the number of copies in Printer and slip layout . Weight slip, two copies on one sheet. # Inwards token A small slip handed to the driver on arrival, showing the tare weight and time in. Inwards token (A5). # Tax invoice A GST invoice with buyer details, HSN, quantity, rate, CGST/SGST (or IGST), round-off and net total, plus the terms you set up. Tax invoice for a sale. # Print again Open Weighment → Sale (or Purchase ). Find the vehicle in Previous receipts by number or vehicle. Press Weight slip or Tax invoice and then Print . Tip Using a thermal roll printer? Choose the roll size and the printer in Printer and slip layout and receipts go straight to it with no print dialog.

s: What you see, what it means, and what to do. Start at the top of the table.
h: Quick fixes · I am locked out of the Admin account · Check what the database holds · Where the logs are
x: # Quick fixes What you see What it means What to do Starting Weighbridge… stays on screen The app is waiting for its database to wake up. This is normal for a few seconds after Windows starts. Wait. It opens by itself. After about 20 seconds it explains the problem and keeps retrying. Can t connect to the database SQL Server isn t running or can t be reached. Open Services on Windows and start SQL Server (…) . Press Try again . On a client computer, check the server computer is on. The Weighbridge service isn t responding The background service didn t start. Close and reopen the app. If it repeats, restart the computer. Weight shows … or Waiting for stable weight… No weight is coming from the scale, or it isn t steady. Check the indicator is on and the cable is in. See Weighbridge and COM port . Activate Weighbridge appears on a computer that worked yesterday The license couldn t be checked for longer than its grace period, or it has expired. Check the internet, then press Activate / Check now . If the license expired, contact Mochan Labs. See License renewal . Tally Sync says Tally can t be reached Tally isn t open, or Host/Port are wrong. Open Tally with the company loaded, then use Test Connection in Tally . Receipts print the wrong size Paper setting doesn t match the printer. Printer and slip layout : choose A4 or the right roll size. A report is empty The date range doesn t cover the day you want. Widen From and To . See Reports . A user can t see a screen Their role doesn t have access. An administrator changes it in Users, roles and permissions . Update message appears A new version is available. Choose to download. Keep working. Restart when asked. See Update the app . Starting Weighbridge… while the database connects. If it takes more than ~20 seconds, the app says what is wrong and keeps trying. # I am locked out of the Admin account Open Command Prompt as administrator on the Weighbridge computer and run: C:\Program Files\Weighbridge\resources\api\Weighbridge.Api.exe --reset-admin-password This sets the Admin password back to Admin@123 and asks for a new one at the next sign-in. # Check what the database holds C:\Program Files\Weighbridge\resources\api\Weighbridge.Api.exe --diagnose-database It prints which SQL Server instance the app uses and how many users, parties and vehicles it holds. # Where the logs are The app writes its log files to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Weighbridge\logs . Send the newest file to support with a short description of what you were doing.

s: The name, address and GSTIN printed on every slip and invoice.
x: Open Administration → Company details . Company details shown on slips and invoices. Field Used on Legal name The heading of every weight slip, token and invoice. Address Under the name on the tax invoice. GSTIN Top left of the tax invoice. Also used for the Tally company when Tally needs it. Phone , Email Printed on the invoice. Logo URL Optional logo image. Press Save . New receipts use the change immediately. Receipts already printed stay as they were. Important Check the legal name and GSTIN carefully. They appear on tax invoices.

s: Connect the weighing indicator so live weight appears on the Token page.
h: Steps
x: The indicator sends the weight to the computer through a serial (COM) port or a USB-to-serial adapter. Open Administration → Weighbridge and COM port . Choose the port, then check Live status. # Steps Connect the indicator to the computer. If you use a USB adapter, plug it in. Open the page and press Rescan . Each port is listed with its description (for example USB Serial Port (COM3) ) so you can tell which one is the indicator. Choose the COM Port . Set Baud rate , Data bits , Parity , Stop bits and Flow control to match the indicator s own settings. The common values are 9600, 8, None, One, None. Set the Frame delimiter and Parser that match your indicator brand (the manual or Mochan Labs will tell you). Press Test Connection , then Save . Live status should say Connected . The Recent raw frames panel shows exactly what the indicator is sending. It is the quickest way to see if the settings are right. If you see garbled text, the baud rate or parity is wrong. If you see nothing, check the cable and the port. Note Using simulator (no hardware required) is for training and demos only. Turn it off on a real weighbridge. Tip Don t have the indicator for a while? Users with the Approve override permission can enter the weight manually (with a reason). See Weigh a vehicle .

s: The products you sell and buy, with their standard rate, HSN code and GST percentage.
x: Open Masters → Materials . Each material has a rate, an HSN code and a GST %. Column Meaning Code , Name What operators pick on the Token page. Rate The standard rate per unit. Parties can have their own ( Parties and party rates ). HSN code The tax classification printed on the invoice. GST % Applied to the taxable amount of every sale of this material. Press Add to create a material, or the edit icon to change one. Note GST is taken from the material , not typed on each bill. Set it correctly once. A change affects new bills only.

s: Your customers and suppliers, and the rate each one pays for each material.
h: Parties · Party rates
x: # Parties Open Masters → Parties . A party is a customer or a supplier. The party master. Press Add and fill in the name, city, phone and, if the party has them, GSTIN and PAN . Credit limit records how much credit the party is allowed. Tip Keep one entry for walk-in customers (for example Cash ) and use it for cash sales. # Party rates Open Masters → Party Rates , choose a party and set, for each material: This party s rate : the rate this party pays. Deduction / Qtl : an amount taken off that rate for every quintal. Billed rate (shown for you) = rate − deduction. Rates for one party. Materials with nothing set are billed at the standard rate. Press Save on a row to keep it, or Clear to go back to the standard rate. When you bill a sale for this party, rate and deduction fill in automatically.

s: Registered vehicles, their RFID tags and saved empty weights.
x: Open Masters → Vehicles . The vehicle master. Column Meaning Registration The vehicle number operators type (or that an RFID tag fills in). Code Your own short code. RFID tag The tag on the vehicle, if you use RFID ( Cameras and RFID ). Stored empty weight The vehicle s known tare. Used for the Known-tare shortcut on the Token page. Owner , Advance Shown if Owner + PAN on vehicles is on in Workflow settings . Vehicles are also added automatically the first time a new number is weighed. Note A saved empty weight saves a weighing, but a fresh live weighing is always allowed. The shortcut is only a suggestion.

s: Paper size, copies, the weight unit, and the wording printed on slips and invoices.
h: Paper · Unit for slips, invoices and billing · Wording
x: Open Administration → Printer and slip layout . Paper, copies per sheet and the unit used on slips, invoices and billing. # Paper Choice Use it for Normal sheet (A4 / Letter) Any ordinary printer. The Print button opens the usual Windows print dialog. Thermal receipt roll, 80 mm or 58 mm A receipt printer. Pick the Thermal printer from the list and receipts print straight to it, with no dialog. On A4, Copies per sheet sets how many copies sit side by side (2 gives two copies on a landscape sheet). Note Thermal printing straight to the printer works in the installed Weighbridge app. In a plain browser tab, the normal print dialog is used. # Unit for slips, invoices and billing Choose Kilograms , Quintals (1 Qtl = 100 kg) or Tonnes (1 t = 1000 kg) . This changes only how weights are shown and billed : on slips, on invoices, in the quantity filled in at billing, and in the quantity sent to Tally. The weighbridge always measures and stores kilograms, and the government portal always receives kilograms. Important Set the unit before you start billing and keep it. Rates are per this unit. A rate of 70 per Qtl billed in kg would be wrong by 100 times. # Wording Field Where it prints Show the weight unit on printed slips Heading of the weight column, for example Weight (Qtl) . Footer note Bottom of every slip. Weight slip terms The numbered notes at the foot of the slip. Invoice tagline Under the company address on the tax invoice. Invoice terms The terms at the foot of the tax invoice. Vehicle photos on slip Whether vehicle photos are printed on the slip. Press Save . See the results in Print and reprint receipts .

s: Who can sign in, and what each person is allowed to see and do.
h: Users · Roles and permissions
x: # Users Open Administration → Users . Each user has a role, a status and the time of their last login. Action How Add a user Press Add user , enter a Username , a Role and an Initial password . The status shows Temp password until the person sets their own at first sign-in. Change a role Pick another role in the Role column. Lock or unlock The padlock icon. A locked user can t sign in (status Locked ). Accounts also lock after 5 wrong passwords. Reset a password The key icon. The person sets a new one at the next sign-in. Remove The bin icon. The user can no longer sign in. # Roles and permissions Open Administration → Roles and permissions . Choose a role on the left. On the right is a grid of every screen with six switches: Permission Lets the person… View Open the screen and see its data. Create Add new records. Edit Change existing records. Delete Remove records. Print Print from the screen. Approve override Do exceptional things, for example enter a weight by hand on the Token page. Tick what each role may do. Press + to create a new role. Press + to create a role, for example Weighbridge operator , and tick only what that job needs. Changes apply to everyone in the role straight away. Tip Give operators View , Create and Print on Token, Sale and Purchase only, and keep Approve override for a supervisor.

s: Turn optional features on or off, set default rates, and choose how sale bills are numbered.
h: Weighing and masters · Default rates for billing · Sale bill numbers
x: Open Administration → Workflow configuration . Everything is optional. Turning a switch off never deletes anything already entered or billed. It changes what happens from then on. Switches for optional features, then default rates below. # Weighing and masters Switch What it does Dual-location weighing (River + Factory) Adds a second weight field on Purchase, for material that arrives with a weight from the point of extraction. Known-tare shortcut on Token entry Suggests a vehicle s saved empty weight. Owner + PAN on vehicles Shows owner and PAN on the vehicle master and fills them in for known vehicles. Production / conversion tracking Adds a Production screen for sites that convert raw material (for example boulders into graded stone). Leave off if you don t need it. # Default rates for billing Further down the page, set the figures that Purchase and Sale billing fill in for you: GST , Income Tax , Transit fee , GST on transit , Permit fee , and Royalty GST % and rate; and, for sales, default Freight , Tax % (fallback) , Kaanta , Daala , Incentive and Round Off . Your accountant can tell you the right values. # Sale bill numbers By default a sale s bill number is its token number. To use invoice-style numbers instead: Turn on Use a bill-number series for sales . Set an optional Prefix (for example INV/ ) and Digits (zero-padding, so 12 becomes 0012 ). Use Start / change next number to to set where numbering continues. Leave it blank to carry on. Optional: Only number sales that charge GST keeps the series free of non-GST sales. Save. Note The number is given when the sale is completed, one after another, so two sales billed at the same moment never get the same number.

s: Optional hardware — vehicle photos on every weighing, and RFID tags to fill in the vehicle number.
h: Cameras · RFID reader
x: Both are optional. A weighbridge with neither works fully. # Cameras Open Administration → Cameras . There are four positions: Bottom , Front , Rear and Top . Each has its own panel. One panel per camera position. Turn the camera on ( Enabled ). Enter its IP address , Username and Password . These are on the camera s label or in its manual. Open Advanced only if the camera needs a different stream path, port, transport or timeout. Press Save , then Test Connection . The Live stream preview appears once it is saved. When cameras are enabled, the Token page asks for all photos before it lets you save, and the photos are stored with the weighing. Cameras that are off are skipped. # RFID reader Open Administration → RFID reader . Choose the connection, then check Live status. Choose the Connection type : Serial (COM port) or a network socket, depending on the reader. For a serial reader, choose the COM Port (press Rescan if it isn t listed) and match Baud rate , Data bits , Parity , Stop bits and Flow control to the reader. Choose the Parser for your reader and Save . Register each tag against its vehicle in Vehicles (the RFID tag column). When a registered vehicle reaches the reader, the Token page fills in its number and shows Tag … → UK… . Tip Recent raw frames shows what the reader sends. If it stays empty while you swipe a tag, the port or settings are wrong.

s: Post every sale and purchase to Tally automatically, and see exactly why when it can't.
h: Connect · Syncing
x: Weighbridge posts a voucher to Tally for each completed sale and purchase. If a customer or material is new to Tally, it is created there the first time it s billed. You don t set up the chart of accounts by hand. # Connect Open Administration → Tally setup . The in-app Setup guide (PDF) walks through both sides. Connection and ledger names. In Tally, open the company you want and turn on its connection for other software (the HTTP gateway). Note the port Tally listens on. In Weighbridge, enter Host / IP ( localhost if Tally is on this computer) and the Port . The default is 9000, but a Tally installation may use another number. Use the one Tally shows. Enter the Company name in Tally exactly as Tally spells it, then the GSTIN and the names of your Sales , Purchase and GST ledgers. Press Save , then Test Connection . This checks that Weighbridge can reach Tally. Switch on Posting real vouchers to Tally . Important The company name must match Tally exactly . Tally refuses a voucher for a company name it doesn t recognise. # Syncing Vouchers are sent in the background automatically. Tally Sync (top bar) and Sync Now (this page) send everything waiting right away, and tell you the result: how many were sent, or why nothing could be, such as Tally isn t reachable . If Tally was closed, nothing is lost. Entries wait and are retried. See Sync status for the list and reasons. The quantity and unit sent to Tally follow the unit you chose in Printer and slip layout .

s: Send each weighment to the Uttarakhand MDTSS portal, with test mode and automatic retries.
h: Set up · Day to day
x: If your weighbridge must report to the Uttarakhand MDTSS portal, Weighbridge sends each weighment for you, always with the weight in kilograms . # Set up The department issues credentials for each weighbridge: an API key , a weighbridge number (WBNo) , a Lessee ID and a refresh token . Open Administration → MDTSS govt portal . Credentials issued by the department. The switch at the top controls whether anything is really sent. Enter the API key , Weighbridge Number (WBNo) , Lessee ID and Refresh token . Leave the Base URL and Refresh token path as they are unless the department tells you otherwise. Press Save . Scroll to Send Test Submission , fill in a test vehicle and weights and press the button. It sends a made-up ticket, not tied to any real weighment. You can repeat it safely while you sort out credentials. When the test is accepted, switch on submission at the top (the label changes from Not submitting to MDTSS (logged only) ). Note While submission is off, weighments are only logged . Nothing reaches the portal. Turn it on only once the test works. # Day to day Sending happens in the background after each weighment. Govt Sync (top bar) sends anything waiting right now. If the portal or internet is down, weighments wait and retry. See Sync status to review them.

s: Daily log, sale and purchase registers, and how to export them to Excel or PDF.
h: Daily Log · Sale Reports · Purchase Reports · Other reports
x: Open the Reports menu. Every report has an Export button (Excel or PDF) and a date range or date picker. If a report looks empty, widen the dates first. # Daily Log Everything that happened on one day. Choose a Date , then switch between two tabs: Weighment Log : each completed weighing with direction ( Inward / Outward ), time, vehicle, material, party, Gross , Tare and Net . Token Log : every token, including ones still open. A day #39;s weighments at a glance. # Sale Reports Choose From , To and optionally a Party . Tabs: Sale List , Product Wise , User Wise and Kaanta Charges . Invoice, date, vehicle, material, party, weights and amount. # Purchase Reports Choose From and To . Tabs: Purchase List , Summary , Gate Wise , Division Wise , Vehicle Wise , Balance Report and Vehicle Summary . The list shows net weight, amount, GST, net amount, gate, division, owner and PAN, with a Total Net Amt . Purchases with GST and net amounts. # Other reports Report What it shows Client List Your parties and their details. Vehicle History Every weighing for one vehicle. Audit Log Who did what and when: sign-ins, changes and manual-weight overrides. MDTSS Sync Status See Sync status . Tip Export before you change a master record you want to compare, for example parties or rates.

s: See what has gone to Tally and the government portal, what is waiting, and what failed and why.
h: The totals · Needs attention
x: Open Reports → MDTSS Sync Status . It covers both Tally and the government portal. Totals on top; anything that failed is listed with the reason and a Retry button. # The totals One row per kind of message ( Tally.PostVoucher , Government.SubmitWeighment ) and status: Status Meaning Pending Waiting its turn. It will be sent automatically. Sent Delivered. Failed It didn t work this time (for example Tally was closed). It retries on its own. Dead-lettered It kept failing and stopped retrying. Fix the cause, then press Retry . # Needs attention Each problem entry shows What (for example Tally.PostVoucher — Sale 6 ), Status , Tries , Next try and the Reason in plain words. The reason tells you what to fix, such as No connection could be made to localhost:9000 (Tally isn t open or the port is wrong). Fix the cause (open Tally, correct the port, restore internet). Press Retry on one entry, or Retry all . Nothing is lost while something is down. Entries wait until they can be sent. Tip The Tally Sync and Govt Sync buttons in the top bar also tell you the result as soon as you press them.

s: Take a safe backup in one click, and keep a copy somewhere other than this computer.
h: Restoring
x: Open Administration → Backup and maintenance . Press Backup now. Existing backups are listed with their size and date. Press Backup now . When it finishes, the backup appears in the list with its File , Size and Created time. A backup is a normal SQL Server backup of the Weighbridge database. It is safe to run any time, even during work, and it doesn t disturb any other backup schedule on the computer. Important The file is written to SQL Server s own backup folder on this computer . If the computer or its disk fails, that copy goes with it. Copy backups to a USB drive or cloud storage regularly, for example weekly and before every update. # Restoring A restore is done by Mochan Labs or your IT person with SQL Server tools. Send the backup file to support if you need help.

s: Weighbridge checks for new versions when it starts and updates only when you say so.
h: Automatic check · Check yourself · Which version do I have?
x: # Automatic check Each time Weighbridge starts, it checks for a new version. If there is one, it asks: Download it now? Choose Yes to download. You can keep working while it downloads; a progress bar shows how far it is. When the download is complete, the app asks to restart . Choose Restart now , or Later . If you pick Later , the update installs automatically the next time you close the app. Your data is never touched by an update. Tip Update at a quiet time, such as the start of the day or after the last vehicle, and take a backup first. # Check yourself Open Administration → About and press Check for updates . The same prompts follow. This only works in the installed Weighbridge app, not in a browser tab. Version, license and the Check for updates button. # Which version do I have? About shows the Version and when it was last updated.

s: How to see your license status, what the expiry notice means, and how to renew.
h: Check your license · Expiry notice · Renew · No internet?
x: # Check your license Open Administration → License . Status, owner, expiry date, last check and this computer #39;s ID. Row Meaning Status Active means everything is fine. Licensed to The business the license was issued to. Expires The date, with the number of days left. Last verified The last time this computer checked in with the license server. This computer s ID A unique ID for this computer. Quote it if you contact Mochan Labs about the license. Press Check now to check immediately. The same details, with the Valid until date, are also under About . # Expiry notice In the last 30 days before expiry, a notice appears every time someone signs in and again in About , telling you the date. It does not stop anyone working. It is a reminder to renew. # Renew Contact Mochan Labs ( support ) and renew the license. Press Check now on the License page. The new expiry date appears. There s nothing to reinstall and no key to type again. If a license expires and isn t renewed, the app returns to the activation screen until it is. # No internet? The app keeps working for the grace period on your license (normally 7 days) without checking in. Connect the computer to the internet within that time.

s: Let a manager's PC and an operator's PC share the same data — one Server, any number of Clients.
h: On the Server computer · On each Client computer
x: If more than one computer needs the same data (for example the weighbridge computer and an office PC), one computer is the Server and holds the database. Every other computer is a Client that connects to it. A site with one computer needs nothing here: it is already a Server. Open Administration → Multi-machine setup . The in-app Setup guide (PDF) shows the same steps. On the Server: its database, address and a pairing code for each client. # On the Server computer Choose Server . It shows Ready for Client connections with the database name , IP addresses and port (normally 1433). Press Generate pairing code . It is the only thing you have to type on the other computer. # On each Client computer Install Weighbridge and activate it. Open Multi-machine setup , choose Client and enter the pairing code. Save and restart the app. It now uses the Server s data. Note Saving takes effect after a restart. This changes which database the whole app uses, so don t do it in the middle of weighing. Important The Server computer must be on for the Clients to work. Keep its backups current.

s: The terms used across the app and these pages.
h: Default roles
x: Term Meaning Token The record opened when a vehicle first arrives and is weighed. It stays open until the vehicle is exited. Entry weight / first weight The weight recorded when the vehicle arrives. Exit weight / second weight The weight recorded when it leaves. Gross Vehicle plus load. Tare The empty vehicle. Net Gross minus tare: the material. Sale (Outward) A vehicle loaded at your site (exit heavier than entry). Purchase (Inward) A vehicle unloaded at your site (exit lighter than entry). Qtl (quintal) 100 kg. MT / t Metric tonne, 1000 kg. Bill / Invoice number The token number, or the next number in your bill series. Party A customer or supplier. Party rate The rate a particular party pays for a material. Kaanta The weighing charge. Daala A loading/handling charge. Frate Freight. HSN The tax classification code printed on the invoice. CGST / SGST / IGST The GST components on an invoice. Royalty, M11, Form J Mining royalty and the transit permit paperwork some purchases carry. MDTSS The Uttarakhand government weighbridge reporting portal. Tally The accounting software Weighbridge posts vouchers to. Override Entering a weight by hand, with a reason, when the scale can t supply one. Dead-lettered A sync message that stopped retrying and needs a manual Retry . Server / Client In a multi-computer site: the computer holding the data, and the ones that connect to it. # Default roles Role Typically used for Administrator Everything, including users, setup and integrations. Power Operator Day-to-day work plus supervisor actions. Operator Weighing and billing at the platform. Roles are fully editable in Users, roles and permissions . These are only starting points.
